name: Yavni Frost-Skin

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Wrecking Blow
abilities.description: A melee attack that deals moderate physical damage and knocks you back if it connects. This attack can be blocked to knock the enemy off balance.

abilities.name: Brawler
abilities.description: Yavni Frost-Skin swings their weapon around, dealing minor physical damage to all enemies in front of them and gaining a shield. This attack has no red cone indicator.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.description: Yavni Frost-Skin casts a Raly-like ability, making them lift their weapon upwards, granting themselves increased damage done instantly and more over time. When the effect ends, it heals Yavni Frost-Skin

summary: Yavni Frost-Skin is a Nord who can be found in the Frozen Ring of the Dragonstar Arena. He wields a greatsword.
